title: SWE-Duel：面向编码智能体的自扩展竞技场
summary: 提出SWE-Duel自扩展基准，任务与判定在评测时生成，避免数据泄漏与饱和。红蓝双方智能体在真实仓库上互评：红方实现新功能并植入隐蔽bug，蓝方盲审修复。11个模型在15个仓库、5种语言进行1500轮锦标赛，GPT-5.5修复98.3%缺陷，Claude Opus 4.8红方胜率27.3%，并发现任务难度随作者能力提升而扩展。
summary_en: SWE-Duel introduces a self-scaling coding benchmark where tasks and oracles are generated at evaluation time, preventing leakage and saturation. Two agents duel over mirrored Red-Blue turns on real repositories: Red implements a feature with a hidden bug, Blue reviews blind. In a 1,500-turn tournament across 11 model-harness participants and 15 repos in 5 languages, GPT-5.5 repaired 98.3% of defects and Claude Opus 4.8 achieved a 27.3% Red win rate, with evidence that task difficulty scales with authoring capability.
